You can replace the images in this directory to customize the launch image
for your application.

The image filenames referenced by Contents.json (LaunchImage.png,
LaunchImage@2x.png, LaunchImage@3x.png) are optional — Xcode will not fail
the build if they're absent, it simply falls back to the LaunchScreen
storyboard, which is what this project uses for its dark, on-brand splash
screen. See ../Base.lproj/LaunchScreen.storyboard.
